Apply for a business subscription

For the Owner of an electronics business or a money services agent. A new business can start one 7-day free trial on the Dukan ERP portal; paid access afterwards is arranged with the platform.

What does your first store do?

Each store has its own activity and price. You can ask for another activity later from your business account.

A code will be sent to your WhatsApp number to prove it is yours. An email address is optional.
